user.title: Connect to the Payday Budget add-on
user.description: Enter the add-on's host name and the integration token shown in the add-on UI under Settings.

data_description.host: The add-on's host name, shown on its info page (e.g. 416b9a6e-payday-budget).

hassio_confirm.title: Payday Budget add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Payday Budget integration for the {addon} add-on?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Payday Budget
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on rejected the stored token. Paste the token from the add-on UI under Settings.

init.title: Reminder notifications
init.description: Reminders always show as a Home Assistant notification. Choose where else to push them.

data_description.notify_services: Notify services, e.g. your phone's mobile_app_… service. Leave empty for none.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the Payday Budget add-on.

invalid_auth.message: The Payday Budget add-on rejected the token.

not_loaded.message: Payday Budget is not set up or not loaded.

invalid_amount.message: Invalid amount {amount}: use a positive number with at most {digits} decimals.

ambiguous_category.message: More than one category matches {category}; give the kind or use the id.

ambiguous_budget.message: More than one budget matches {budget}; use the id.

ambiguous_tag.message: More than one tag matches {tag}; use the id.

invalid_period.message: Invalid period {period}: use current, previous or a period id.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Positive amount in major units, e.g. 12.50.

budget.name: Budget
budget.description: Budget name or id. Required for expenses, not allowed for incomes.

date.name: Start date
date.description: Defaults to today. Cannot be in the future.

name.name: Name
name.description: Defaults to the month and year of the start date.

get_summary.name: Get summary
get_summary.description: Returns income, expenses and budgets for a period.

period.name: Period
period.description: current, previous or a period id.

list_transactions.name: List transactions
list_transactions.description: Returns transactions matching the filters, newest first.

period.name: Period
period.description: current, previous or a period id.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category name or id; a name in both kinds needs kind.

user.name: User
user.description: Home Assistant user id that created the transaction.

add_category.name: Add category
add_category.description: Adds an income or expense category.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An mdi icon. Defaults to mdi:tag.

update_category.name: Update category
update_category.description: Renames, re-icons, archives or changes the kind of a category.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Picks the category when its name exists in both kinds; otherwise changes its kind (only without transactions).

archived.name: Archived
archived.description: Archived categories cannot be used for new transactions.

record_reminder.name: Record reminder
record_reminder.description: Records the transaction for a due reminder. Fields left out come from the reminder.

occurrence.name: Reminder
occurrence.description: Id of the due reminder (from the reminders sensor).

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Positive amount in major units, e.g. 12.50.

budget.name: Budget
budget.description: Budget name or id. Expenses only.

dismiss_reminder.name: Ignore reminder
dismiss_reminder.description: Ignores a due reminder; it does not come back.

occurrence.name: Reminder
occurrence.description: Id of the due reminder (from the reminders sensor).

delete_category.name: Delete category
delete_category.description: Deletes a category without transactions; archive it otherwise.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Needed when the name exists in both kinds.
